rounds.notes:
Focus on making money by waiting for the fight to start (allowing you to heal and damage at the same time) and then using both your [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) one after the other on as many people as you can see, the reason for doing this is it maximises the burst damage meaning you are more likely to get a kill from it (which is why we get [Pulsar Plus](item_4795ae1f-580d-47ec-a01d-0933cba56212) round 1), giving extra cash.

Make sure to prioritize healing your team with your blaster when not shooting missiles, as its easy cash and allows them to get more as well since they aren't wasting time dying.

round_upgrades.notes: Great for money making, very important for build up-time

rounds.notes:
Here we rush to get [PulStar Destroyers](item_707ad8c7-a153-4140-b4bc-1f23f7d7a648) as soon as possible as it is central to our build and is equivalent to a 40% damage increase already, and this scales even better than it seems, as after tests I discovered it adds a flat increase of 35 (which is increased by your AP) to give you a new base damage, which is then affected AGAIN by your ap to give your final damage. To put it simply, it applies the damage before AP is counted leading to much larger damage.

Continue using your [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) in pairs to maximise kill potential.

round_upgrades.notes: Incredible damage:cash ratio, must buy and core of the build
Great for money making, very important for build up-time

rounds.notes:
From here, we choose [Torpedo Glide](item_b04180a3-c2b2-409c-959e-77e3af6bc7d8) and can now use our already lethal [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) even more frequently, make sure to use glide boost so that its still active when the missiles land to get the cooldown reduction from them. Remember that they only give cooldown reduction if they land on an enemy, targeting allies doesn't count as it doesn't damage them. Also the cooldown reduction is limited to one second per missile, so even if an individual missile does 150 damage, its not going to take 3 seconds off of your cooldown, but 3 50 damage missiles will (missile base damage is 85 anyway). Ensure that you continue shooting at enemies during your glide as you can get roughly 1-2 seconds of cooldown reduction from each burst shot landed on an enemy during this period.

Continue building [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) as much as you can afford, so long as you prioritize [PulStar Destroyers](item_707ad8c7-a153-4140-b4bc-1f23f7d7a648).  [Multi-tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) is a very nice cheap item to pick up as it gives 10% AP and 5% cdr which is very helpful in this build.

As a side note, [Lock-On Shield](item_220287f8-1dc5-4a6c-9e86-c14cf970b689) is NOT worth buying anymore since it got nerfed so much, it gives you a measly amount of overhealth for 4,000 and you would be much better maximising your lethality, ensuring that even if you die you can at least trade it out in the process.

rounds.notes:
Here we grab [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) which is a MUST pick in any [Juno](hero_035c63b7-084c-4abd-9de5-c9a00e9b6a18) build, as each bullet counts as a separate tick of damage/healing allowing you to gain the full 25% AP from a single burst shot on any teamate or enemy, which is an insane damage increase for only 11,000 - and you get a bonus 10% weapon power for free.

As in round 3, continue building ability power prioritizing [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) and [PulStar Destroyers](item_707ad8c7-a153-4140-b4bc-1f23f7d7a648)

rounds.notes:
Here we have a few options, [Medicinal Missiles](item_30eeab6c-4a1e-4a16-b9dd-e83d633caa40) is a very powerful option to ensure you keep up your heals, and since you are already using so many missiles with high AP it fits in perfectly, however if your other support is carrying the heals, or you really just don't need them you can choose between [Cosmic Coolant](item_5584169d-94af-4efa-955c-263353a75553), which gives you a flat 0.5s cooldown reduction for every player hit (this includes teammates, unlike [Torpedo Glide](item_b04180a3-c2b2-409c-959e-77e3af6bc7d8)), or if you are willing [Blink Boosts](item_9bac3119-781b-4dc0-94fa-9c293c02dc90) is a potential pick to maximise the cooldown reduction you can have, however this comes at the cost of making the build much more difficult to play as it requires good timing and managing your cooldowns, and I find its extremely difficult to use without [Boosted Rockets](item_c3e0738f-cce2-431a-ad52-39176df84923), as the glide duration is so short its hard to land the missiles during that time.

For our items, we pick up [Pulse Spike](item_6557a6d1-9c94-4635-9619-67257e26683e) which can make your life easier with its 35% torpedo speed if you chose [Blink Boosts](item_9bac3119-781b-4dc0-94fa-9c293c02dc90), however this passive also makes your double [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) combo much more lethal regardless of the power you chose, as it gives them far less time to react and get into cover after noticing them. Its 25% attack speed boost also combos perfectly with our build as after firing the [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) you should still be in glide boost, allowing you to get more damage off with your gun and further reduce the [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) cooldown before the glide boost runs out.

With any remaining cash, continue building [Ability Power](stat_ability_power)

For our power we have the same choices as round 5, here the safe option is [Cosmic Coolant](item_5584169d-94af-4efa-955c-263353a75553), however feel free to pick what you enjoy the most.

Continue building [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), but [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) is a very nice pick now we have the money for it as its 10% [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) is very powerful with this build along with its high 20% [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) stat.

For this last round go all out, try and single out a support (especially ana) to quickly one shot with a double [Pulsar Torpedoes](ability_fd63ee02-e01a-49bd-a75d-0e78efafca88) combo before the fight starts and you have a very good shot at winning the fight.
